rev6.release_notes: Simulate (lathe): Auto stock at the top of STOCK - it guesses the bar from the program; type an OD or Length to set your own, the Auto stock button turns the guess back on. OD / ID labels, Front Z starts at .1. Groove and Cutoff tool types (DOVETAIL reads as a groove), inserted drills cut with a flat point, and a nose radius in the tool comment (R.0156) is used.

cadcam.release_notes: Beta 2: the CAD / CAM switch stays where you put it; clicking a setup (or Ctrl-picking toolpaths) shows all their toolpath lines; six new tool models for Simulate (1/2, 3/4 and 1 in end mills, a No. 3 center drill, a 1/4 in drill, a 1.25 in face mill).
